items.item_text: Master-s degree in Nursing, Health Services or Business Administration, Public Health, Finance, or related discipline such as Public Administration required.
Minimum ten (10) years relevant and progressive management experience.
Experience with budgeting and financial management
Strategic planning, both long term and short term, for the KP Care at Home services and products across the SCAL and Hawaii market
Strategic market integration of the KP Care at Home shared services model within SCAL, Hawaii, and our external KP partners
Develops and leads the KP Care at Home service line operations including strategic planning, operational execution, cost and quality evaluation, and workforce management

Leads the strategic oversight, planning, operational performance, and relationship management for our external home health, hospice, palliative care, and durable medical equipment partners (external partners exceed 100 different contracts)
Accountability for efficiency, cost and care effectiveness, safety, and quality performance all of the KP Care at Home services
Strategic leadership, management, and development of the financial planning and operational monitoring of budgets associated with KP Care at Home
Leads, monitors, and course corrects Medicare fee for service billing practices
Strategic leadership for program development of KP Care at Home service line as opportunities and needs of the SCAL/Hawaii markets evolve
Strategic workforce management of the skills and expertise of staff needed to execute on the strategic and operational plans of KP Care at Home

The VP of KP Care at Home will lead, partner, and participate in Kaiser Foundation Health Plan/Hospital Oversight activities to ensure systems, processes, resources, expertise, and measurements are in place to provide ongoing support of quality, safety, and regulatory oversight activities

Strategic and operational partnerships for the KP Care at Home service line with our Permanente Medical Group leaders, Enterprise and Market leaders across program, and external leaders to ensure safe, reliable, and accessible care is available for all who need our services
Participation in Enterprise Leadership committees including: Enterprise Continuum Leadership Committee;Enterprise KP Care at Home leadership committee
Must be able to work in a Labor/Management Partnership environment.
Demonstrated ability to perform strategic planning, implementation, evaluation, and course correction processes and systems that deliver health care services
Ability to demonstrate communication, presentation, leadership, analytical and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to lead and manage change using interpersonal skills such as negotiating, collaborating, influencing
Strategic leadership knowledge of quality assurance, quality improvement, resource management, health plan regulatory and licensing processes
Demonstrated ability to achieve results on both a strategic and operational level performance
